caption: The drawing features a large, cylindrical stone or marble object with intricate carvings sitting at the center of the composition. The main object is depicted in shades of gray with some brownish coloring around the central opening on the top surface, suggesting depth and wear. The surface of this object includes two main decorative bands: the upper band contains carved grape clusters and leaves in high relief, while the lower band is composed of vertical, rounded, bead-like elements. The top of the object is flat with a large central hole, surrounded by four smaller holes arranged symmetrically. At the bottom left corner, there is a smaller, monochrome sketch showing the same object as a base supporting a stylized candelabrum or plant holder with three upward branches, each holding a decorative motif. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects present.
title: Carved Stone Urn
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
